note: Target-coverage ratchet (agentStateRail.targetCoverage.test.js). Finding ids may only be REMOVED, and only when FIXED (their case is still generated and now passes): UPDATE_TARGET_LOCK=1 rewrites the lock, refuses to add an id, and refuses when a case that held a finding is no longer generated. caseSet locks each capability's generated cases (count + hash of every case id). overRefusal is reported, never locked. `decisions`: { id: reason } keeps a locked id whose case vanished or that no longer reproduces, on purpose.
